mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, reducing spironolactone metabolism and increasing serum potassium levels through enhanced mineralocorticoid receptor antagonism, elevating hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider alternative antibiotic (e.g., doxycycline, amoxicillin) or adjust spironolactone dose if combination is necessary.
